summary: Copper Property CTL Pass Through Trust filed an 8-K reporting a monthly cash distribution of $0.081790 per trust certificate, payable September 10, 2026 to holders of record September 9, 2026, alongside its monthly reporting package and a revised 2026 annual budget. No board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics were disclosed. The distribution reflects ongoing liquidation-style monetization of the trust's legacy JCPenney property portfolio, with proceeds from property sales and rents funding certificateholder payouts. Watch monthly sales pace and any budget revision signaling weaker rent or disposition timing.
